JXPATH-113.label: I
JXPATH-113.reason: This report is about a NullPointerException in `ChildContext.prepare()` when iterating children of an empty root node. That is a different traversal phase and failure mode than `following::node()` / `preceding::node()` axis selection. It shares the general XPath navigation domain, but not the specific node-test logic or the DOM/JDOM pointer mechanism implicated by the current bug.

JXPATH-109.label: I
JXPATH-109.reason: This is about wildcard attribute selection in `DOMAttributeIterator`, specifically prefix matching for `@*`. It is in the DOM model and involves node-test matching, but the data type and mechanism are attributes vs. general node axis traversal. The current failure concerns `node()` matching in DOM/JDOM pointers for following/preceding axes, so the overlap is only very loose.

JXPATH-111.label: R
JXPATH-111.reason: This report is directly about `preceding::node()` and a bug in `PrecedingOrFollowingContext`, which is the same axis-navigation machinery exercised by the failing tests. Although the reported symptom is a `ClassCastException` rather than incorrect node matching, it targets the same regional code path and the same `node()` axis semantics in traversal over DOM/JDOM nodes.
